title: Strict-local representative section pullback
statement:
theorem strictLocal_section_pullback
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : CommSq g' f' f s)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Scheme.strictLocalization s)
    (hpoint : ∀ j : SmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
      t ≫ (Scheme.strictHenselizationAffineCone s).π.app (op (op j)) ≫
        (Spec (unop ((equivSmallModel.{u}
          (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1.left)).isoSpec.inv =
        ((equivSmallModel.{u}
          (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).2.left)
    (q : X' ⟶ pullback f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))
    (hqt : q ≫ pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s) = f' ≫ t)
    (hq : q ≫ pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s) = g')
    (j : SmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)) :
    qcqsStrictLocalSectionRestriction Λ f s F j ≫
      globalSectionsUpperStarMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s))).obj F) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ _ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
        ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) q
          (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)) g' hq.symm).inv.app F) =
      geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq F
        ((Scheme.AffineEtale.Spec Y).obj
        ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1)
        ((equivSmallModel.{u} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).2 ≫
      (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _
        (IsTerminal.isTerminalOfObj
          (MorphismProperty.Over.forget @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ X')
          (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X')) Over.mkIdTerminal)).inv.app
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F)

proof.text: Expand qcqsStrictLocalSectionRestriction and geometricFibreSectionRestriction. Identify terminal evaluation with ΓRes and use terminal uniqueness and unit naturality to compute globalSectionsUpperStarMap at the identity étale object. Move the strict-local restriction past the q-unit and the inverse upperStarComp comparison. Use upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app, cancel the comparison isomorphisms, and evaluate the resulting composition-unit identity at f*V. Identify the remaining lift with geometricFibreSectionLift by pullback hom-ext: the inner first projection follows from hqt and hpoint j, the inner second from hq, and the outer second from the over-category equations. Cancel terminal evaluation isomorphisms. This is the adopted canonical full strictLocalization realization; its proof is preserved verbatim. The obsolete small-model consumer applications are replaced in their own nodes by the general composition theorem and projection extensionality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q9 and 0A3U; existing adopted-source proof via terminal evaluation, composition-unit coherence, and pullback projections; F1 retirement, 2026-10-22.

mathlib_searches.results: Both searches unavailable: Internal Server Error.

mathlib_searches.query: A canonical isomorphism of modules between the stalk of an etale direct image and global sections on the strict henselization base change, with germ formula; exchange compatibility with fibre restriction
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits per query, on structure-sheaf stalk maps in Spec/AffineScheme, Scheme.stalkMap_germ, and ModuleCat.Tilde.germ_comp_stalkToFiberLinearMap. These concern Zariski structure-sheaf or tilde stalks, not the etale direct image or exchange.

12 hits including presheafFiber_hom_ext, toPresheafFiber_naturality, toPresheafFiber_w, and toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc. These are general colimit tools, not the desired etale comparison or exchange identity.

mathlib_searches.query: strictHenselization|baseChangeMap|strictLocal in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites; qcqs.*[Ss]talk|strictHenselization.*[Cc]omparison|baseChangeMap.*[Gg]erm in the project library
mathlib_searches.results: No Mathlib sites hits and no exact library theorem. The library has the set-valued continuity theorem and the module/set inverse-image comparison; the finite base-change stalk-restriction theorem only computes pointwise restrictions, not the global-section factorization.

mathlib_searches.query: Pullback of a sheaf section along a commutative square agrees with the adjunction unit on a marked etale neighbourhood
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, topological sheaf pullback and unrelated scheme/open immersion results; no etale strict-local section formula.
No hits (identifier not known by Mathlib-only loogle).

Found the proved representative calculation in geometricFibreExchange_germs, reused to prove exchange_pointed_representative. No existing strict-local section pullback identity; restriction naturality concerns refinement, not pullback to the fibre.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image adjunction unit compatible with restriction of sections along a composite scheme morphism
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: Zariski Scheme.Modules restrictAdjunction/restrictFunctorComp and scheme structure-sheaf appLE maps; none computes strict-local etale module sections.
One generic adjunction uniqueness/unit lemma; it helps identify canonical units but does not give this section-pullback identity.

QcqsStrictLocalRestrictionNaturality concerns neighbourhood refinements only. IntegralFibreSectionLocalLiftAux has a stronger existential integral comparison with sorry, not the canonical arbitrary-q formula. Coherence contains the proved composition-unit identity, but the terminal evaluation and projection calculation remain to be formalized.
